{{Quote|If you carry a cold drink outside on a hot day, heat travels from the hot air into the cold liquid. Soon, your drink is warm. A thermos would act as insulation, keeping the heat out of your cold drink.|[[4B-X]] to [[Stuart Zissu]]|<ref name="Science">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]''</ref>}}
A '''thermos''' was a container that acted as insulation and could be used to keep liquids cold in a hot environment.<ref name="Science" />
